description.value:
From Sticky Fingers · Put a zipper on anything and open it.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 action: stand places a zipper on a surface up to 5 ft thick and opens a passage through it until your next turn; you can also hide a light item inside a zippered surface. When your stand hits, the target attempts @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude}: failure, it drops one held item.
  • 5: 2 actions: zip yourself along a surface, moving up to 30 ft without triggering reactions.
  • 9: Reaction, surge: when a melee attack would hit you, unzip your body so it misses (once per round).
  • 13: Passages work through walls up to 20 ft thick and last 1 minute.
  • 17: Critical failure on the hit save also detaches a limb: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 2} and it can't use one hand for 1 minute.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
